verdict.rationale: Gmail's documented REST API, with OAuth scopes, lets a programmatic client read and manage threads, messages, and labels, create and send drafts, and send messages, so a user's own agent can cover read, triage, draft and send. There is no evidence of a ready-made connection for Claude or ChatGPT, and the machine-readable discovery probes (llms.txt, OpenAPI) returned 404. Community reports also note Google restricting third-party app access. missing for 10: an official agent connector or MCP server for Claude/ChatGPT, machine-readable agent docs (llms.txt/OpenAPI), independent hands-on evidence of an agent completing the full read→triage→draft→send flow, and clarity on OAuth verification hurdles for consumer accounts.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an external agent — Claude, ChatGPT, or my own — can read, triage, draft, and send my email end to end through a documented connection
